summary: Smith+Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an LSE announcement) disclosing the pricing of USD 700,000,000 5.750% Notes due 2036, priced September 9, 2026. Net proceeds of USD 690,928,000 will fund the repurchase of its outstanding 2.032% Senior Notes due 2030 via a concurrent tender offer and related fees, with the remainder for general corporate purposes. The offering is set to close September 11, 2026, subject to customary conditions; BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, Mizuho and SMBC Nikko are named. This is a routine refinancing shelf takedown, not a standalone special situation; the tender-leg is the incremental event to monitor.
